integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard free-Lie-algebra identifications, with a complete central-map linear-algebra classification and a standalone executable finite verification. This record does not claim independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the free metabelian nilpotent Lie algebra on two generators of class four. It does not classify all higher classes or arbitrary nilpotent Lie algebras. Computational checks cover only fields of orders 2, 3 and 4; the universal argument is algebraic. Publication priority is provisional and independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: The isolated binary almost-inner derivation of a free class-four Lie algebra
